jobs.title: Senior IT Product Owner-Onsite
jobs.description:
Job Details:

As a Senior IT Product Owner, you are accountable for maximizing measurable business value and ensuring the right problems are solved before production investment . You will collaborate closely with experienced product managers and cross-functional teams and gain hands-on experience in defining product vision, strategy, and roadmap aligned with business objectives and market needs. Leveraging your strong analytical skills and passion for technology, you'll assist in gathering market insights, conducting user research, and prioritizing features to drive product development and innovation. You'll support the execution of product initiatives, assisting in coordinating activities such as sprint planning, backlog grooming, and user acceptance testing. With guidance and mentorship from seasoned professionals, you'll have the opportunity to develop your skills in product management, agile methodology, and stakeholder communication. As an integral member of the product management team, you'll act as a trusted advisor to business leaders, product managers, engineering, and governance bodies. You will play a crucial role in delivering value to our customers and contributing to the success of our tech products and services.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities:
- Single point of accountability for problem clarity, solution intent, and value realization end ‑ to ‑ end. Challenge, frame, and validate problems worth solving, including defining value hypotheses and success measures.
- Product Research: Conduct market research and competitive analysis to understand market trends, customer needs, and competitor offerings.

- User Feedback Analysis: Gather and analyze user feedback through surveys, interviews, and usability testing to identify pain points and opportunities for improvement. Establishes feedback loops before development, testing usability, assumptions, and value prior to build.

- Requirements Gathering: Work closely with stakeholders, including customers, sales, marketing, and engineering teams, to gather and prioritize product requirements. All requirements must include a current and future state process map to be shared and signed off with your sponsor.
- Product Planning: Assist in creating and maintaining the product roadmap, defining features, and release timelines based on business objectives and user needs.
- Cross-Functional Collaboration: Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including design, engineering, marketing, and sales, to ensure alignment and execution of product initiatives.
- Feature Prioritization: Owns an outcome ‑ driven backlog, with acceptance criteria tied to business outcomes and user impact—not outputs. Help prioritize features and enhancements based on their impact on user experience, business value, and technical feasibility.

- Project Coordination: Coordinate project activities, tasks, and timelines, ensuring that milestones are met and deliverables are completed on time and within scope. Manages small projects end-to-end.
- Documentation: Create and maintain product documentation, including user stories, feature specifications, and release notes, to communicate requirements and updates to stakeholders.
- Testing and Validation: Assist in functional and user acceptance testing (UAT) and validation of product features to ensure they meet quality standards and user expectations.
- Performance Monitoring: Assist in defining and tracking key performance indicators (KPIs) and metrics to measure product performance and success.

- Continuous Improvement: Continuously seek opportunities for improvement, gathering feedback from users and stakeholders to iterate on product features and enhance the overall user experience. Drives continuous optimization using real ‑ world usage data, analytics, and AI ‑ enabled insights.

- Learning and Development: Stay informed about industry trends, best practices, and emerging technologies in product management, seeking out learning opportunities to grow and develop in the role.
- Customer Support: Provide support to customer-facing teams, including responding to customer inquiries, addressing product-related issues, and assisting with customer training and onboarding.
- Team Collaboration: Collaborate with product management peers and other team members, sharing knowledge, insights, and best practices to foster a culture of collaboration and continuous learning.
- Strong Communication Skills: Excellent communication and presentation skills, able to articulate complex ideas, influence diverse audiences, and drive stakeholder alignment.
- Leadership and Mentorship: Experience mentoring and guiding junior team members, contributing to their professional growth and the overall success of the product team.
- Industry Knowledge: Understanding of the industry in which the company operates, including trends, competitive landscape, and regulatory considerations.
- Lifecycle Accountability: End ‑ to ‑ end accountability from idea inception through post ‑ release value realization and adoption analytics.
- Governance & Risk: Responsible for audit ‑ ready, defensible decisions, supporting Finance, Audit, and Executive Steering. Operates security & privacy ‑ by ‑ design, threat modeling, and data protection standards—especially for AI and integrations.
- Perform other assigned job-related duties that align with our organization's vision, mission, and values and fall within your scope of practice.

Qualifications:
Education: Bachelor's Degree or relevant experience. ( Preferably Computer engineering, computer science, or information systems)
Preferred Certification(s): Any relevant IT Certification.
Experience: 3+ years of relevant or practical experience.
Special Skills:
- Methodology: Intermediate knowledge of Agile Product & Waterfall methodology.
- Communication: Effective communication, able to present to senior leadership.
- Decision-Making: Value-based decision-making.
- Problem-solving: Analytical skills for diagnosing and solving issues.

- Organization: Managing time, prioritizing tasks, and handling responsibilities.
- Prototypes: Uses visuals, prototypes, and data ‑ backed narratives to communicate complex decisions clearly.
- AI: AI ‑ enabled discovery, prototyping, and validation are core capabilities (workflow modeling, mockups, scenario analysis). Executes responsible AI principles (transparency, explainability, bias awareness, data stewardship).

** Not eligible for visa sponsorship now or in the future **
** Not eligible for relocation assistance **

All professional team members are expected to demonstrate responsible use of approved AI tools, including safeguarding sensitive information, adhering to company policies, and validating AI-generated outputs. Individual Contributors should demonstrate the ability to integrate AI into daily work, improve efficiency through AI-enabled solutions, evaluate outputs critically, and apply professional judgment when using AI. People Leaders should demonstrate the ability to drive responsible AI adoption, enable effective use of approved solutions, identify opportunities to improve team performance through AI, and ensure accountability for the quality and accuracy of AI-supported outcomes.

jobs.title: Lead Business Analyst, Data & Analytics Product Management
jobs.description:
Job Details:
What is the role?
This team is focused on transforming Tyson Foods Beef & Pork division through data, enabling better decisions, improved processes, and stronger customer and team member outcomes. The Lead Analyst plays a key role in that transformation by partnering across business and IT to translate business requirements into data products.

This role works closely with business leaders to understand strategies, data needs, operational processes, and how analytics can drive measurable value. The focus is on defining business requirements, shaping data and reporting solutions including AI, and delivering insights that support both day-to-day operations and enterprise initiatives.

Responsibilities span the full analytics lifecycle — from requirements gathering, definition, refinement, prioritization , and data modeling alignment to supporting delivery of reporting, dashboards, and advanced analytics use cases. This role also contributes to larger transformation efforts by ensuring data is trusted, aligned to business definitions, and enabling consistent decision-making.

The ideal candidate is a strong problem solver who can connect business context to data, challenge assumptions, and drive clarity. This individual will play a critical role in enabling data-driven decisions, improving transparency, and influencing how Tyson leverages analytics to deliver business results.

Job Responsibilities
Act as the IT partner to the business, aligning data products through requirements gathering to business goals and delivering best-in-class data solutions.
Strong subject matter expertise in Food Industry business processes and technical capabilities.
Experience leading complex transformation initiatives that impact business process and technology, ideally legacy system experience.
Actively participate and help guide IT data gathering and data architecture strategy, integration, and deployment activities across analytics space.
Cultivate strong business relationships by demonstrating an understanding of related processes, requirements, systems, and terminology. A strong candidate will have expertise in transforming business reporting from Excel to enterprise analytics.
Partner with stakeholder teams across business units to document necessary business cases to frame opportunities, benefits, and risks to decide on a course of action
Stay current with stakeholder needs and strategies by developing a communication process utilizing formal and informal methods to communicate updates and findings and facilitating project meetings and presentations to all types of diverse audiences (e.g. senior management, customers, technical staff)
Work with business and IT Leadership to develop IT analytics strategies and technical roadmaps
Coordinate, influence, and gain alignment of cross-functional business & IT teams to develop scalable and strategic solutions that meet business needs
Assist in the project delivery of multi-business technology solutions and must have significant exposure to and demonstrated proficiency in the areas of analysis, design, software requirements, configuration, automated testing, and implementation.
Partner with software vendors on functionality roadmaps and critical issues to ensure vendor solutions are aligned with business roadmaps and initiatives
Maintain awareness of best practices including processes and technology and identify opportunities for improvement of existing functionality to support business processes
Analyze and interpret information technology proposals and evaluate and develop alternative implementation plans
Lead cross functional meetings & organize/deliver information to audiences at all levels within the company, including executive stakeholders
Handle multiple engagements simultaneously without compromising accountability or reducing level of engagement
Provide work leadership and direction to junior analysts within the team; to mentor and elevate their level of capabilities
Develop strong working relationships with business partners, peer IT teams and vendors

Requirements:
Experience: 5+ years of experience in Information Systems or related area with proven experience as a business analyst
Requires a Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or other technical area In depth understanding and knowledge of IT standards and controls, Kimball data modeling methodology in a medallion raw-clean-curated architecture
Experience developing and communicating a capability/application roadmap
Computer skills: Strong proficiency in SQL, BigQuery (or similar cloud based technologies), Microsoft PowerPoint, Excel, and Word,
Communication skills: Excellent written, verbal and presentation skills with demonstrated ability to tell the “story”.  Experience communicating technical information to stakeholders, peers, senior management, and non-technical team members.  Experience communicating functional requirements to highly technical team members.
Ability to work collaboratively and effectively across the team with a growth mindset towards action and learning
Ability to work independently and set priorities based on key milestones, impact to strategic initiatives and high-level direction of management
Extensive strategic problem-solving skills; ability to assess situations and demonstrate sound decision quality
Advanced ability to build relationships and influence strategy
Ability to handle multiple projects simultaneously in a high-paced environment

Preferred Experience:
Analytics Product Owner Experience in Complex transformation from Excel to GCP with Power BI
Technical Skills for Legacy System: SQL, DB2

jobs.title: Senior IT Product Owner
jobs.description:
Job Details:
Tyson Foods, Inc. has an opening for Senior IT Product Owner in Springdale, AR. Support the planning and execution of application development and enhancement projects to gather market insights, conduct user research and prioritize features to drive product development. Elicit, analyze, and document functional and technical business requirements, including user stories, to support automated and optimized technology solutions in compensation analytics domain. Document complex business and technical processes using Business Process Model and Notation (BPMN). Develop mockups and prototypes to validate requirements and gather stakeholder feedback. Create test plans and develop and execute unit, system, and integration test cases for software releases. Test plans include data and web development validations. Analyze business processes, system requirements, and technical workflows to support application functionality and integrations with approved systems. Identify opportunities to improve existing systems and enable process automation through technology enhancements in a fast changing environment. Research, develop, and utilize tools and technologies to improve solution delivery and system performance. Collaborate with business users, vendors, and IT teams to support application integrations and ongoing system capabilities. Create and maintain system documentation, including support procedures, to ensure continuity and service quality. Provide guidance and technical feedback to junior analysts and data scientists within the team. Deliver application support within established service level agreements (SLAs) to meet departmental performance metrics.

Job requirements:

Requires a Bachelor’s degree or foreign equivalent in Computer Science, Information Systems, Financial Analytics, or a related field, and three (3) years of experience in the position offered or related role, including supporting application system integrations, including data flows, interface dependencies, and upstream/downstream system interactions.
Alternatively, the employer will accept a Master’s degree or foreign equivalent in Computer Science, Information Systems, Financial Analytics, or a related field, and two (2) years of experience in the position offered or related role, including supporting application system integrations, including data flows, interface dependencies, and upstream/downstream system interactions.

Experience must include one (1) year of experience in each of the following:

Translating complex business requirements into detailed functional and technical specifications for enterprise-level application systems. Designing and documenting system workflows and integrations using Business Process Model and Notation (BPMN) or equivalent formal process-modeling frameworks. Utilizing Agile and Waterfall software development methodologies in enterprise IT environments. Implementing process automation and system enhancements to improve operational efficiency and reduce manual workflows. Performing technical troubleshooting and root-cause analysis for application and system issues in production and pre-production environments. Using requirements management and issue-tracking tools (Jira or equivalent) to manage technical deliverables and development lifecycles.

Please submit resume online through this site.

Relocation Assistance Eligible:
